review:
A blacksmith's forge with bellows, anvils and hammers on 5x3. Wilds carry 2x to 10x multipliers that add up when several are in one win.

Three scatters start free spins, with mini reels deciding how many you get. In the bonus, every wild sticks for a random number of spins – you never know how long a good one will stay, which adds real tension. 96.52% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
